breaking_news.headline: As many are priced out of buying, the renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever
breaking_news.summary: Record high housing costs have pushed the wealth gap between renters and owners wider than ever. It's been a boon for owners even as many others are priced out.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA has a new plan to raise billions of dollars: Selling stakes in the World Cup
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has a complex plan to sell chunks of its commercial rights to the World Cup to minority investors, including a firm run by Joshua Kushner, the brother of Jared Kushner.

breaking_news.headline: More Americans are going bankrupt. What does that mean?
breaking_news.summary: The bankruptcy rate has risen about 48% between 2022 and 2025, although it's still below pre-pandemic levels.

breaking_news.headline: A divided Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady despite high inflation
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged Wednesday.  Fed policymakers say they remain committed to curbing stubborn inflation.

breaking_news.headline: The renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever, as many are priced out of buying
breaking_news.summary: Housing has long been the largest source of wealth for middle income families. But many renters cannot afford to buy as housing prices soar, which could fuel a generational divide.

breaking_news.headline: The economy slowed a bit -- but Americans continued to spend
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. economy grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in the spring, according to the Commerce Department. That's a modest slowdown from the previous quarter — but consumer spending picked up steam.

breaking_news.headline: European soccer leaders to boycott  the World Cup in an unprecedented step
breaking_news.summary: In an unprecedented step, European soccer associations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.

breaking_news.headline: Are you choosing to stay single? We want to hear from you
breaking_news.summary: Solo living, solo travel, and solo dining are all being embraced as more adults are choosing to remain single. Many Americans aren't interested in dating, and being single is a symbol of autonomy.

breaking_news.headline: Father of teen school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
breaking_news.summary: "It is clear you failed as a parent," the judge told Colin Gray, who was found guilty earlier this year on charges stemming from the deadly 2024 school attack.

breaking_news.headline: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
breaking_news.summary: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

breaking_news.headline: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
breaking_news.summary: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

breaking_news.headline: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
breaking_news.summary: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

breaking_news.headline: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
breaking_news.summary: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

breaking_news.headline: Hundreds of migrants swim from Morocco to Spanish enclave of Ceuta
breaking_news.summary: The territory's leader said the influx is overwhelming resources and urged the Spanish government to intervene.

breaking_news.headline: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
breaking_news.summary: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

breaking_news.headline: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
breaking_news.summary: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

breaking_news.headline: The Chinese robot army transforming the UK's retail industry
breaking_news.summary: Britain's weak productivity growth and labour shortages are creating an opportunity for China's robotics firms.

breaking_news.headline: Beauty Pie founder on how she dropped out of university and built five beauty businesses
breaking_news.summary: Marcia Kilgore, founder of Beauty Pie, shares her top tips on how to create a successful business.

breaking_news.headline: Shell profits double as oil prices rise due to Iran war
breaking_news.summary: Disruption to global supplies of oil and liquid natural gas through the Strait of Hormuz has pushed up prices.

breaking_news.headline: Hundreds of jobs to go at Jaguar Land Rover
breaking_news.summary: The car giant says it expects fewer than 300 people will lose their jobs.
